restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes, encoded from two independent uniform 256-bit words.
One batch of exactly n = 9 * 2^125 samples (an exact integer loop bound); all repeated messages are retained and charged; no restart or success amplification.
One selected 2-round compression per sample; single 64-byte block, no parent or extra compression is ever evaluated.

Collision detection by deterministic stable LSD radix sort of the full 256-bit digest (eight 32-bit digit passes, 2^32 native 256-bit word counters that cannot overflow) followed by one linear scan; no hash table, no probing, and no distributional premise on digests.
Every ledger entry is a deterministic worst-case bound over all coin sequences and every fixed target, priced at 1/C per word operation with C = 430; no expected value appears anywhere.
Classical 256-bit word RAM with independent uniform random words; all initialization, sorting, scanning and verification charged.
Analytical generic construction; no full-scale execution, precomputed collision, or empirical heuristic is claimed.
The nominal reference identifier does not assert an improvement; the bound 128.9 improves the promoted best 140.
